FIELDS.NAME: Safe Haven Storage
FIELDS.MAILING ADDRESS: 1234 Safe Haven Rd, Suite 100, Springfield, IL 62704-1234
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Safe Haven Storage, we operate a secure self-storage facility designed to meet the diverse needs of our customers. Our facility includes single-story and two-story units that comply with the latest fire safety and building codes, ensuring a safe environment for all stored belongings. Each unit is equipped with electronic access systems and monitored by a 24/7 surveillance system to ensure continuous security.

We proudly offer a variety of storage solutions, including standard and climate-controlled units, catering to residential, business, and student storage needs. Our on-site staff is committed to maintaining cleanliness and conducting regular inspections, ensuring every unit is well-kept and secure.

We also provide packing supplies for our customers, enhancing their storage experience with convenient access to boxes, tape, and other necessary materials. Our team is dedicated to excellent customer service, with an emphasis on transparency and regulatory compliance through proper documentation of all contents within our portable storage units.

At Safe Haven Storage, we prioritize safety, security, and customer satisfaction in all aspects of our business.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2022, a small water leak from an overhead pipe caused damage to five storage units. The cause was traced to an aging plumbing system that required maintenance. The total loss was estimated at $1,200, and repairs have been completed, with all affected customers compensated for their losses. The situation has since been resolved.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: "Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Saturday: 9:00 AM - 4:00 PM; Sunday: Closed"
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Secure self-storage facility with grade A vaults, monitored fire suppression systems, and electronic access controls.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Secure perimeter fencing, 24/7 surveillance cameras, and on-site security personnel.
